message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without your password. If you’ve forgotten it, the best approach is to use the “Forgot Password” feature on the website or app. That will send a reset link to the email address associated with your account, allowing you to create a new password securely.

If you’re having trouble finding that option or need further assistance, let me know and I’ll guide you through the steps.
